name: Van Gogh Vibes Pictures
description: A curated gallery of rare Van Gogh masterworks available as digital art purchases. Each painting is unique and individually priced from $0.01 to $0.08 USDC. Payments are processed via the x402 micropayment protocol on the Base network.

browse.description: Retrieve the full catalog of available artworks with metadata (id, title, year, description, vibe tags, price)

purchase.description: Purchase and retrieve a specific artwork. Send GET request; server returns 402 with payment requirements. Sign an EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization for the required USDC amount and retry with the X-PAYMENT header.

payment.note: Each artwork is priced individually; query /api/catalog for exact per-item prices.
